title: Rule Test Cases and Minimal Pairs

tests.before: The list of items are ready.
tests.after: The list of items is ready.
tests.reason: The head subject is singular.

if.value: The list of items is ready.

tests.before: Maya told Priya that she had won.
tests.after: Maya told Priya, “You won.”
tests.reason: The intended referent is made explicit; another intended meaning would require a different repair.

if.value: Maya told Priya, “You won.”

tests.before: After reviewing the proposal, the price seemed high.
tests.after: After reviewing the proposal, we thought the price seemed high.
tests.reason: The reviewer becomes the subject.

if.value: After reviewing the proposal, we thought the price seemed high.

tests.before: The server stopped, the queue kept growing.
tests.after: The server stopped, and the queue kept growing.
tests.reason: Two independent clauses receive a valid boundary.

if.value: The server stopped, and the queue kept growing.

tests.before: My brother who lives in Calgary called.
tests.after: My brother, who lives in Calgary, called.
tests.reason: Use only when the speaker has one contextually identified brother; restrictiveness changes punctuation.

if.value: My brother, who lives in Calgary, called.

tests.before: Select Delete if you no longer need the file.
tests.after: If you no longer need the file, select Delete.
tests.reason: The condition appears before the potentially destructive action.

if.value: If you no longer need the file, select Delete.

tests.before: The implementation of the update was performed by the team.
tests.after: The team implemented the update.
tests.reason: Actor and action become visible.

if.value: The team implemented the update.

tests.before: Heading: More information; section: Reset your password.
tests.after: Heading: Reset your password
tests.reason: The heading predicts the task.

if.value: Heading: Reset your password

tests.before: We will reply soon.
tests.after: We will reply within two business days.
tests.reason: A decision-relevant time becomes testable.

if.value: We will reply within two business days.

tests.before: This treatment works.
tests.after: In the cited trial, this treatment improved the measured outcome for the studied group.
tests.reason: Scope and evidence boundaries are restored.

if.value: In the cited trial, this treatment improved the measured outcome for the studied group.

tests.before: The user should enter their email.
tests.after: Enter your email.
tests.reason: The reader is addressed directly.

if.value: Enter your email.

tests.before: She entered the room, looked around, and left unchanged.
tests.after: She entered to apologize; she left after discovering the letter was gone.
tests.reason: The scene changes goal-relevant knowledge and plan.

if.value: She entered to apologize; she left after discovering the letter was gone.

tests.before: People who carry umbrellas are near rain; umbrellas cause rain.
tests.after: Umbrella use is associated with rain because people carry umbrellas when rain is likely.
tests.reason: The causal claim becomes an association with a plausible direction.

if.value: Umbrella use is associated with rain because people carry umbrellas when rain is likely.

tests.before: 1. Open Settings. Requirement: You need administrator access.
tests.after: Prerequisite: Administrator access. 1. Open Settings.
tests.reason: The prerequisite precedes execution.

if.value: Prerequisite: Administrator access. 1. Open Settings.

tests.before: Click Save.
tests.after: Select Save.
tests.reason: The instruction works across input methods.

if.value: Select Save.

tests.before: Cause: The token expired. Fix it.
tests.after: Symptom: Sign-in returns “token expired.” Generate a new token, retry sign-in, and confirm the account page opens.
tests.reason: Troubleshooting starts from observation and ends with verification.

if.value: Symptom: Sign-in returns “token expired.” Generate a new token, retry sign-in, and confirm the account page opens.

tests.before: The best analytics platform.
tests.after: See conversion sources by campaign, page, and form in one report.
tests.reason: Generic superiority becomes a specific verifiable capability, not an unsupported ranking.

if.value: See conversion sources by campaign, page, and form in one report.

tests.before: Only three spots left!
tests.after: Three onboarding appointments remain for September; booking closes when they are filled.
tests.reason: Use only when operations verify the capacity and period.

if.value: Three onboarding appointments remain for September; booking closes when they are filled.

tests.before: Heading: Details
tests.after: Heading: Eligibility requirements
tests.reason: The heading works out of context.

if.value: Heading: Eligibility requirements

tests.before: Choose the green button on the right.
tests.after: Select Submit order.
tests.reason: The label survives color perception and reflow.

if.value: Select Submit order.

tests.before: Invalid input.
tests.after: Enter an email in the format name@example.com. Your other form entries are still saved.
tests.reason: The error explains recovery and state.

if.value: Enter an email in the format name@example.com. Your other form entries are still saved.

tests.before: Plans start at $10.
tests.after: Plans start at $10 per month for one user; taxes are extra.
tests.reason: Material price conditions appear with the price.

if.value: Plans start at $10 per month for one user; taxes are extra.

tests.before: Source: The result may reduce risk. Edit: The result prevents harm.
tests.after: The result may reduce risk.
tests.reason: The edit must not inflate modality or evidence.

if.value: The result may reduce risk.

tests.before: Jordan asked Lee to revise their section.
tests.after: Query: Does “their” refer to Jordan, Lee, or a jointly owned section?
tests.reason: The system asks rather than inventing the referent.

if.value: Query: Does “their” refer to Jordan, Lee, or a jointly owned section?

tests.before: Revision is shorter but removes a safety condition.
tests.after: Reject the revision and restore the condition.
tests.reason: Outcome gates override local concision.

if.value: Reject the revision and restore the condition.
